title: 8 Things That Tripped Me Up Implementing x402
description: 8 Things That Tripped Me Up Implementing x402

_signals.x_guidance: x402 endpoints (Base mainnet, $0.01 USDC): GET /api/v1/x402/report — x402 spending history for a Base wallet; GET /api/v1/x402/services — x402 service registry; GET /api/v1/content/{slug} — paid blog content. MPP endpoints (Tempo chain, $0.001 USDC): GET /api/v1/report — MPP spending report (also accepts JPYC payment: 2 JPYC on Polygon mainnet eip155:137 via x402-jpyc facilitator https://x402-jpyc.vercel.app — include EIP-3009 signature in X-Payment header); GET /api/v1/insights — cost optimization tips; GET /api/v1/services — MPP service registry. For MPP endpoints use mppx or Tempo CLI. For x402 endpoints use @x402/fetch or CDP wallet.
